title: Take me out of my way. Hate company when you.
html_source: Bloom doesn’t want to stop and have what comedian Larry David calls ‘a stop and chat’ but is too polite to fob M'Coy off. Bloom remains cordial throughout the pleasantries and even cleverly manages to dodge M'coy’s suitcase ruse (see Grace, Dubliners). Leopold Bloom’s got game!
